raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Cantilever fixed boundary",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 calls the problem a 'classic 2D cantilever' and mentions 'fixed-boundary corners', but gives no constrained-node set or support span. The setup is assigned to the unavailable Fig. 3.",
      "readings": [
        "Clamp the entire left edge: x=0, 0<=y<=100 mm.",
        "Clamp only the two left corner nodes: (0,0) and (0,100) mm.",
        "Clamp two left-edge attachment patches: x=0 with y in [0,10] or [90,100] mm."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "100 MPa traction on the right edge",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 says 'to the right edge'; Sec. 4.4, returning to this cantilever, says 'at the center of the right edge'. Neither specifies a loaded span or resolves an entire-edge traction versus a localized load.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform 100 MPa traction over the entire right edge: x=200 mm, y in [0,100] mm.",
        "Uniform 100 MPa traction over a centered 10 mm patch: x=200 mm, y in [45,55] mm.",
        "Uniform 100 MPa traction over two central edge segments: x=200 mm, y in [49,51] mm.",
        "A concentrated nodal force at (200,50) mm, representing 100 MPa over a 1 mm tributary edge length and the stated 1 mm thickness: resultant magnitude 100 N."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Right-edge structural traction",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 4.1 and 4.4 provide traction magnitude and location information but no direction. The downward traction specified in Sec. 4.3 belongs to a different, doubly clamped example.",
      "readings": [
        "Vertically downward: traction vector (0,-100) MPa.",
        "Vertically upward: traction vector (0,100) MPa.",
        "Horizontally outward, normal to the right edge: traction vector (100,0) MPa.",
        "Horizontally inward: traction vector (-100,0) MPa."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Protected material at supports and load application",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The density formulation and Sec. 4.1 do not explicitly identify passive masks or state whether support and load attachment elements remain designable.",
      "readings": [
        "All 200x100 elements are designable; there are no passive solid or void regions.",
        "Hold the first element column, x in [0,1] mm, at rho=1; all remaining elements are designable.",
        "Hold that support column and a load pad x in [199,200] mm, y in [49,51] mm, at rho=1; all remaining elements are designable."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial topology density field",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 3.4 and 4 specify the optimizer and bounds but do not give the initial densities for the Sec. 4.1 baseline. The compositional initialization in Sec. 4.5 does not specify this topology initialization.",
      "readings": [
        "Initialize every designable element at rho=0.5.",
        "Initialize every designable element at rho=1.",
        "Initialize near rho=0.5 with seeded perturbations in [-0.01,0.01], adjusted to retain mean density 0.5."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Unlisted MMA numerical parameters",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Secs. 3.4 and 4 invoke implementation 'default parameters' and 'default asymptotes initialization' without an exact software release or numerical values for the remaining settings. The stated move limit does not determine these parameters.",
      "readings": [
        "Initial asymptote half-width 0.5 times the density-bound range; expansion/contraction factors 1.2/0.7; MMA slack parameters a0=1, a=0, c=1000, d=0; subproblem tolerance 1e-7.",
        "Initial asymptote half-width 0.5 times the density-bound range; expansion/contraction factors 1.2/0.7; MMA slack parameters a0=1, a=0, c=10000, d=0; subproblem tolerance 1e-8."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Optimization stopping test",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 3.5 requires both design and objective changes to fall below prescribed tolerances. Sec. 4 instead specifies a maximum design change of 1e-5 or a 250-iteration cap, without an objective-change test or tolerance.",
      "readings": [
        "Follow Sec. 4: stop at 250 iterations or when maximum raw-density change is at most 1e-5, without checking objective change.",
        "Also require relative elastic-compliance change to be at most 1e-5 before stopping early; retain the 250-iteration cap.",
        "Also require absolute elastic-compliance change to be at most 1e-5 N mm before stopping early; retain the 250-iteration cap."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Elastic equilibrium and sensitivity solve accuracy",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3.3 describes the general equilibrium procedure but supplies no linear-solver choice, numerical precision, or residual tolerances for computing the baseline elastic displacement and its sensitivities.",
      "readings": [
        "Use double-precision sparse direct solves for elastic equilibrium and sensitivity systems.",
        "Use double-precision iterative solves with relative residual tolerance 1e-8.",
        "Use single-precision iterative solves with relative residual tolerance 1e-5."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
